name: SoD-Bench
description: Synthetic procure-to-pay sandbox for money-denominated evaluation of LLM-agent defences against invoice manipulation and payment diversion. Worlds are generated procedurally from seeds; each inbox item carries exact ground truth (payee, legitimate value, attacker account, attack family, split).
citeAs: Hemanth (2026). Segregation of Duties for AI Agents: SoD-Bench. Interim release.
license: TBD by the author before publication
rai:dataCollection: Procedural generation; formats follow UBL 2.1, Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 and a PINT AE-style profile; no personal or real company data.
rai:dataLimitations: Synthetic environment; optimistic human-review model unless an error rate is set; insider fraud and ERP compromise out of scope.
rai:dataUseCases: Defensive evaluation of agent architectures and controls for accounts payable.

recordSet.name: inbox_items
recordSet.description: One record per inbox item of a generated world.

field.name: agent_view
field.description: Exact untrusted text an agent receives
